name: prometheus
description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.
one_liner: The tool that watches your servers and apps and alerts you before something breaks.
buyer: A DevOps or SRE lead at a mid-size company who needs reliable alerting but doesn't want to build it from scratch.
business_use_cases: A managed-ops consultancy sets up and maintains monitoring stacks for startups as a monthly retainer.
A reseller packages hosted monitoring-as-a-service for companies that don't want to run the infrastructure themselves.
An MSP bundles it-based uptime monitoring into existing IT-support contracts as a value-add.

money_ideas.idea: Managed monitoring-stack-as-a-service retainer for startups without SRE staff
One-off setup and consulting to instrument a client's infrastructure

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'monitoring and alerting in a day' setup service to startups who keep getting surprised by outages they can't see coming.
